name: Graviturgy Magic
summary: Wizards who bend gravity to crush and move creatures.

features.name: Adjust Density
features.short: Action: make a creature lighter (faster) or heavier (slower).
features.summary: As an action, you magically alter the weight of a Large or smaller creature within 30 ft. for 1 minute (concentration): halve its weight (+10 ft. speed, jump farther, disadvantage on STR) or double it (-10 ft. speed, advantage on STR).

features.name: Gravity Well
features.short: Move creatures 5 ft. when your spells affect them.
features.summary: Whenever you cast a spell on a creature, you can move it 5 ft. to an unoccupied space of your choice if it is willing, if your attack hits, or if it fails its save.

features.name: Violent Attraction
features.short: Reaction: +1d10 to a weapon hit or fall damage.
features.summary: When a creature you can see within 60 ft. hits with a weapon attack, or takes falling damage, you can use your reaction to add 1d10 (or 2d10 for falls) to the damage. Uses: INT modifier per long rest.

features.name: Event Horizon
features.short: Action: hostile creatures near you take 2d10 force and can't move away.
features.summary: As an action, you emit a 30 ft. field for 1 minute (concentration). Hostile creatures that start their turn in it make a STR save or take 2d10 force damage and have speed 0. Once per long rest (or a 3rd-level slot).
